name: codex-alert
description: Mac screen pulses and phone notifications when a local Codex task finishes.

interface.shortDescription: Know when your long Codex task is done.
interface.longDescription: Set up and manage the Codex Alert menu-bar app: ntfy completion and failure alerts, screen flashes, quiet hours and screen-off operation. Optional approval alerts use separately reviewed Codex hooks. Install the Mac app from Releases or use the source installer.
defaultPrompt: Help me set up Codex Alert on my Mac.
Check whether Codex Alert is running.
Help me turn off phone notifications.
